title: Keywords you'll see everywhere
goal: Read card effects quickly by learning the common bracket words.

steps.html:
Words in [square brackets] are keywords. Here are the ones that tell you when something happens:

  • On Play: when you play the card.
  • When Attacking: each time it attacks.
  • On K.O.: when it gets K.O.'d.
  • On Block: when it blocks.
  • Activate: Main: an ability you choose to use in your Main Phase.
  • End of Your Turn: during your End Phase.

These ones are conditions:

  • Your Turn / Opponent's Turn: only works during that turn.
  • Once Per Turn: can be used only once each turn.
  • [DON!! x2]: only works with 2 or more DON!! given.

And these are abilities:

  • Rush: can attack the turn it's played.
  • Blocker: can take an attack for another card.
  • Double Attack, Banish, Unblockable: make attacks hurt more.

callouts.label: [DON!! x2]: give Sanji 2 DON!! and he gains [Rush], so he can attack right away.

steps.html: When a card does something you didn't expect, the card wins: card text overrides the general rules.

quiz.q: A Character has [On Play] Draw 1 card. When do you draw?
quiz.why: On Play happens once, right when the card is played.

choices: You must use it every turn
It can be used only one time each turn
It works only on your first turn
quiz.why: It limits how often the effect can be used.

quiz.q: Which keyword lets a Character attack on the turn it's played?
quiz.why: Rush removes the usual wait of one turn.
